chapter: On the road and later jobs
title: Records for Ken Mills and a trio with Sylvester Hand
summary: He made records for Ken Mills and played as a trio with Sylvester Hand and a drummer, earning more than with the full band.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Did you ever play in small string groups, just three pieces or so?
Yeah, we used to play for that guy. We made some records for that guy on Santa Lily Street. Do you remember who that fella had? He's got a bad name.
Ken Mills, that's who we played for.
Just with a banjo and guitar and violin or something like that?

No, we had five pieces, but a lot of the boys didn't come. Yeah. So me and the bass player, I think the boys played in the big high range a whole lot. That's John's brother. Oh, you mean Sylvester? Sylvester Hand. Me, Sylvester, and the drummer. Just us three we played again when I was playing my banjo and anything. And we made more money that night we played together, you know, than when the band was in. And somebody come in one night and we had a bad trip and still alive. Mm-hm.
